LightningComponentBundle.description: Lightning Web Component for picking a SOR

property.name: addressText
property.label: Address Text
property.description: if present, displays the address text at the top of the component.

property.name: showCreateReferralButton
property.label: Show Create Referral Button
property.description: If true, a Create Referral button is displayed. Clicking it sets varButtonPressed to REFERRAL, which can be used to control Flow behaviour.

property.name: createReferralButtonLabel
property.label: Create Referral Button Label
property.description: Controls the label displayed on the Create Referral button.

property.name: displayTabs
property.label: Display Tabs
property.description: when true tabs are displayed for the various categories. Disabling this will prevent the search tab from appearing.
